description: None of the two November CSS protest episodes has a simultaneous participant count; all three candidate records remain pending_threshold.
The 6 Nov student protest is inferred from next-day report describing 7 Nov as day two; an independent contemporaneous first-day report was not captured.

Metro Libre reported Colón, Coclé and Villa Lucre actions, but raw body output was not preserved. Per coordinator direction these remain leads only, not verified candidates. Threshold/state target unresolved; no reopen.
La Estrella S003 and Metro Libre S004 body observations were visible but complete rendered responses were not archived; this is documented in their observations.
Six broad Spanish searches focused on CSS, student, labor, provincial/community actions; sectoral and regional coverage remains incomplete. Official baseline remains pending.
